I added `CountUsersInactiveSince` in `services/cron/inactive_users.go`. It's a single line:

```go
func CountUsersInactiveSince(ctx context.Context, since timeutil.TimeStamp) (int64, error) {
	return db.GetEngine(ctx).Where("last_login_unix < ?", since).Count(new(user_model.User))
}
```

It uses the existing `db.GetEngine(ctx)` helper (`models/db/context.go:73`), which already does what you asked: it uses the transaction's session if the context carries one, and otherwise starts a new session bound to the context.
